abstract: This is a case report of an extremely rare Carney complex (CNC) syndrome in a 17-year-old patient. After the decision made by a team of cancer specialists, the patient was admitted to the hospital for surgery because of adnexal tumor associated with ascites and increased Ca 125 tumor marker level. The patient underwent cardiac surgery twice. Adnexal mass and ascites, revealed by transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) and confirmed by magnetic resonance imagings (MRI), indicated the malignant alteration. Surgery was performed and surgical pathological staging was refined according to the FIGO guideline and included a staging laparotomy. After surgery, general condition of the patient was good, without ascites and pain, with Ca 125 marker levels within reference ranges.
abstract_ja: Carney複合（CNC）症候群を有する17歳患者の極めてまれな症例を報告する。チームによる癌専門医の検討を経て、付属器腫瘤と腹水を伴い腫瘍マーカーCA-125の上昇を認めたため、患者は手術のため入院した。経腟超音波（TVUS）と磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）で付属器腫瘤と腹水が確認され、悪性変化が示唆された。手術ではFIGO分類に従い、病期分類を目的とした開腹術を含む外科的病期分類を行った。術後、患者の全身状態は良好で、腹水や痛みは認めず、CA-125は基準範囲内であった。
